items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Fetist is mentioned only as part of the cast for a picture ('Ginger Rogers and Fetist there') with no personal interaction or relationship described between the interviewee and Fetist.

ctx.x: So, uh, the band was pretty good. We were supposed to make a picture and, uh, for Damsel in distress, distressed with, uh, Ginger Rogers and Fetist there. So a little argument came up between Sharky and I, and I told Sharky to go. I didn't want to go. So then we, we stayed there, gradually against each other. And, uh, Nick made enough money there to build a new place across the street, which was 1937, December 10th. I'll never forget it because Red McKenzie was almost killed with a cab. We were carrying the…
Did you make records with Prima from other students?
